name: acornonaut
description: Turn YouTube videos into spaced-repetition flashcards and study them.

interface.longDescription: Acornonaut turns YouTube videos and playlists into spaced-repetition flashcards. Add a video by URL and have cards generated from its transcript, review the cards that are due today and record how well you knew each one, search, create and edit cards and playlists, check your study stats, and export a deck as JSON, CSV, Markdown or an Anki package.
defaultPrompt: Make flashcards from this YouTube video
Quiz me on the flashcards I need to review today
How is my studying going in Acornonaut?

positive.description: Turn a YouTube video into flashcards.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the video was added to a playlist and that card generation has started, and suggests checking back in a minute or two for the cards.

positive.description: Start a study session with the cards that are due.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the Acornonaut flashcards I need to review today.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the first due card's question, waits for an answer, then reveals the answer; if no cards are due it says so.

positive.description: Find cards on a topic across the library.
positive.prompt: Find my flashcards about neural networks.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching cards with their questions, answers and source video, or says that none match.

positive.prompt: How is my studying going in Acornonaut? Give me my stats.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of playlists, videos, completed videos and flashcards.

positive.prompt: What playlists do I have in Acornonaut?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's playlists with their processing status and number of videos.

negative.description: Do not trigger for summarising a video without studying it.
negative.prompt: Summarise this YouTube video in three bullet points: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk

negative.description: Do not trigger for building flashcard software.
negative.prompt: Write me a Python script that implements a spaced-repetition flashcard app.

negative.description: Do not trigger for study reminders, which the app does not support.
negative.prompt: Remind me to study every evening at 8pm.

publication.release_notes: First release.
